caption: The drawing is a technical blueprint on a beige background with dark blue or black ink lines and text, detailing the plan elevations of a table. In the top center, the title reads "PLAN ELEVATIONS OF TABLE, No.#11-161-3-10-FU," along with the scale and measurement information. In the upper left, there is a small diagram labeled "DIAGRAM OF MOULDING" with dimensions 5/8" x 5/8" and a cross-section view labeled "END ELEVATION," showing the profile of molding with measurements and hash marks. To the right, there is a three-dimensional drawing of the top-most section of the table leg, marked with points A and B and curved lines, annotated to describe sectioning at the table's join and specifying scale. Immediately below this, a top elevation of the legs and stretcher, taken from point A, depicts an "X" shape showing the cross arrangement of the table stretchers, connecting at the corners, labeled B. In the main lower portion, there are three major views of the table: a top elevation with a square shape measuring 17" by 17", a front elevation showing one drawer with a round knob centered below the tabletop, and a side elevation showing the profile of one knob, a solid square drawer front, and four straight table legs. Both the front and side elevations note a height of 28 1/4" from the floor to the top. All construction lines and dimensions are drawn with thin, straight strokes, with each view and section labeled accordingly. The composition is organized, with all the components and details spaced evenly, and annotation text written in block letters.
title: Table (Occassional)
